name: crooker
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The crooker is a spirit from British folklore. It haunts the river Derwent, which runs through the English Peaklands. People who traveled there were warned to stay wary of it.

okr.objective: The crooker is a haunting spirit of the Derwent River.
key_results: The crooker is a British folkloric spirit.
